block.description: Provider for generating and encoding puidv7 identifiers (prefixed UUIDv7 in Crockford Base32).

prefix.description: A 3-character lowercase alphabetic prefix (a-z) for the identifier.

uuid.description: The UUID to encode (with or without hyphens).
